defect.note: Narrator says בת אברהם where canonical text is בן אברהם (יִשְׁמָעֵאל is a son of אַבְרָהָם). Word span verified by pinned Whisper transcript (91.20-91.46 for בת) and direct listening (ת release to ~91.52, silence 91.53-91.60, אַבְרָהָם from ~91.60).

original.preserved: archival original and hash unchanged; the edition is a separate artifact

edition.encoder: libmp3lame, 64 kbps, mono, 44100 Hz (same parameters as the original)
edition.revision: Third build. First rendered בןבן (donor ran past בֶּן into בְּתוּאֵל); second clipped יִשְׁמָעֵאל's tail (in-joint at 91.19 s sat inside the word's final vowel). Donor stays pinned to בֶּן alone (50.42-50.74 s); the in-joint now lands a little after יִשְׁמָעֵאל completes (~91.33 s), at 91.34 s, per review.
edition.note: Full-length corrected edition derived from the verified original. One additional MP3 encode generation applies to the whole file; the archival original is untouched and remains the source of record.

target.content: בַּת (consonant+vowel burst ~91.44-91.52) plus the inter-word gap to אַבְרָהָם. יִשְׁמָעֵאל's tail completes ~91.33 s and is fully preserved before the in-joint.

donor.context: לָבָן בֶּן־בְּתוּאֵל — same recording, pasuk 5 (בראשית כח ה); same voice, same maqaf-joined prosody. Window bound by Whisper word timestamps: בֶּן 50.42-50.74 s, בְּתוּאֵל starts 50.74 s; nothing outside בֶּן is spliced.

edits.method: PCM-domain splice at 44100 Hz with 15 ms raised-cosine crossfades at both joints, then a single re-encode at the original bitrate

verification: Edition SHA-256 bound above; original SHA-256 verified against the published S3 object before editing.
Isolated corrected syllable listened to directly: heard as בֶּן, not בַּת.

Whole pasuk 9 of the regenerated edition listened to end to end: '…מָחֲלַת בַּת־יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן־אַבְרָהָם אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת עַל־נָשָׁיו לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה' — exactly one בֶּן, no remnant of בַּת, no audible splice artifact.
Whisper word timestamps re-run on the regenerated edition: יִשְׁמָעֵאל completes at ~91.34 s (full tail, nothing clipped), בֶּן 91.34-91.66 s, אַבְרָהָם follows — a single token, no doubled בןבן.
Secondary report inspected: עֵשָׂו at the start of the same verse completes its final ו sound naturally before אֶל־יִשְׁמָעֵאל — not clipped in the source.
Joint-continuity measured: peak/RMS across both splice joints matches surrounding speech (no clicks).
remaining: Rerun the unchanged full-quality original-MP3 alignment pipeline (Whisper FP32 + forced alignment) against the edition's own source hash — requires the maintainer's alignment worker.
Complete canonical/timing validation, then normal website/native source, playback and packaging verification before publication.
